6.WhatsApp Business Integrations

If we build or operate a WhatsApp Business integration for you:

  • Message templates are reviewed and approved by Meta. Approval decisions, account limits and any restrictions Meta applies are outside our control.
  • Meta charges for WhatsApp Business Platform messages according to its own pricing. These charges are separate from our fees unless your agreement says otherwise.
